exposure: myometrial thickness between the bladder and gestational sac < 2.5 mm
outcome: Treatment failure after methotrexate (MTX) combined with suction curettage (SC) for cesarean scar pregnancy (CSP)
cohort: 127 patients diagnosed with CSP in the early first trimester and initially treated with MTX combined with SC.
finding: Progesterone level > 25 mIU/mL, abundant blood flow, gestational sac size > 3 cm, and myometrial thickness between the bladder and gestational sac < 2.5 mm were independently associated with the need for additional treatment after MTX and SC for CSP.
